create_user_proxy_llm: create a UserProxyLLM instance with an LLMEngine to simulate a human user in agent interactions
reply_to_agent_message: call reply on UserProxyLLM to send a message to the simulated user and get their LLM-generated response
init_conversation_with_agent: call init_conversation on UserProxyLLM to generate an opening message from the simulated user to start a dialogue
review_user_proxy_abc: review the UserProxy abstract base class and its abstract reply and init_conversation methods
refactor_user_proxy_llm_history: refactor UserProxyLLM to support custom system messages and conversation history management for simulated user interactions
